notes.title: Quality of life Update in Hello Engineer is here!
notes.content:
🛠️ Greetings, ingenious builders! Prepare your wrenches, it's tool-time for Hello Engineer! 🛠️

Get ready to dive into some serious mechanical madness with the Quality of life Update rolling your way! 🔥Now, let's dive into the nuts and bolts of what's new with our Steamy Update!

Highlights:

🚀 Aerodynamic overhaul: We've given your creations wings (well, kind of)! Now you can take to the skies with the board part, no engines needed! 

https://i.imgur.com/alSY8yf.gif

⚙️ Snap-tastic Gameplay Changes: We've revamped our snap and connect features, and boy, is it a game-changer! Snap your details, move & attach them wherever you need easily since they now keep the original postion. 

https://i.imgur.com/fMAkavo.gif



Full Patch Notes 
Hello Engineer - Quality of Life Update 

New:

 💨 Aerodynamic: Add wings to your contraptions and let your imagination take flight.
Core improvements:

 🔗 Snap/Connect Features Change: the details now attach keeping their original postion. 
 🌟 Unlimited Resources in Sandbox Mode: We're feeling generous! Enjoy infinite resources and all construction components in Sandbox mode. 

Other: 

 🌐 Display Mass Center: Need to balance your contraption? We've got you covered! We're now displaying the position of the mass center to help you fine-tune your creations.
 🎯 Display Center of Long Parts: Precision engineering at its finest! See the center of those long parts.
 🚙Car no longer can be edited on level 1.
 🛠️ Various bug fixes and small improvements.

notes.title: From scraps to donut cars: Hello Engineer is here!
notes.content:
Greetings, our fellow designers!

The gears are greased, the widgets are whirring, and the blueprints are freshly printed because Hello Engineer is here!

Welcome to the new vehicle construction game, where the only limit is your imagination!

Watch the trailer:

[previewyoutube=m82In9Jgi_k;full][/previewyoutube]

🔧 Build Crazy Contraptions 
Construct awesome vehicles from nothing but scraps, and challenge the eerie Neighbor. Whether you're rolling, flying, or bouncing, if your contraption gets the job done, consider it an engineering masterpiece! 

https://i.imgur.com/04UKiDJ.gif

👷 Solo or Squad 
Whether you're a lone wolf engineer or prefer to tackle nutty challenges with pals, Hello Engineer has got you covered! Team up with up to 4 fellow engineers or build your own chaos in a campaign mode. 

🏞️ Build the machine of your wildest dreams with almost unlimited resources in sandbox mode.  
Once you collect all the parts, you can build anything that hits your mind: cat mobile to your favorite movie car! When you finish your ingenious invention, check how it gets along with the environment and show it to your friends. You can also share the blueprints with your squad to expand the car collection!

https://i.imgur.com/zppN8By.gif

Following the tradition, we can't leave you without a giveaway to celebrate the launch! Join our Steam stream around 9:00 PT to try your luck and snag yourself a Hello Engineer key!

Get ready to crank up the chaos and let the inventive insanity begin. Welcome to Hello Engineer! 🛠️

See you at the park,

notes.title: ⚙️Hello Engineer Demo is back! Release date announcement!
notes.content:
Attention, Inventors Extraordinaire!

It's time to flex those creative muscles and dive headfirst into the incredible world of Hello Engineer. Introducing the Hello Engineer Demo - back, tuned with one additional chapter, and available for playing for a limited time! 

Wait a minute, some amazing news has just dropped like a ton of wrenches – Hello Engineer's Full Launch is roaring in on August 17th! Check out the trailer:

https://youtu.be/DNwxrxs-sb4

To celebrate we're going to to put that pedal to the metal and launch mind-blowing discounts. Snag yourself Hello Engineer on Steam with a 35 % discount during the whole week after the release & stackable 15 %  if you already own one of the these titles: Hello Neighbor, Hello Neighbor 2, Hello Neighbor: Hide and Seek, Hello Neighbor: Search and Rescue VR, or Secret Neighbor!

We know it's hard to wait for all of that but lighten up: we have something to do in the meantime! Let's see what the Demo is about, shall we?

📽️For full immersion into the plot and mastering the basics, we recommend the story mode. 

https://i.imgur.com/1xSEveK.png

Here you'll find yourself trapped in the legendary Golden Amusement, with the help of your notorious Neighbor, also known as Mr. Peterson. Assemble unbelievably shaped and configured vehicles to break free & beat the levels and conquer your creepy Neighbor. 

 🧰 ⚒️Now, after fully preparing for the real challenge, we invite you to a sandbox mode to take your scavenging and crafting skills to new heights. 

You now have almost unlimited resources and treasures like wooden planks, metal pipes, scrawny wheels, and dynamite! Invent awe-inspiring constructions to conquer the landscape & unlock hidden pathways to hard-to-reach places. 

https://i.imgur.com/y1o0qv9.gif

Remember to gather your pals from the Neighborhood Rescue Squad to join the fun and create engineering marvels together!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856190/Hello_Engineer/

Make sure that you have Hello Engineer on your wishlist, and grab the full game with an enormous discount on the launch day! If you liked the Demo, please feel free to join our Discord server. We have dedicated channels just for feedback, and we’d love to hear what you think!

Meet you on August 17th!

Cheers,

notes.title: ⚙ Hello Engineer is crash-landing onto Steam this summer 🌞
notes.content:
Hello, fellow engineers!

We know you've been eagerly awaiting the opportunity to transform questionable scrap into functional works of art. 🎨 Well, the wait is almost over! Get ready to dive into the world of Hello Engineer this summer, and let your creativity soar!

Want a sneak peek? Check out the exciting new teaser trailer:

https://youtu.be/6DnzzxuDLss

But what exactly is Hello Engineer all about? We're glad you asked! 

Welcome to Hello Engineer, a multiplayer machinery-construction game set in the Hello Neighbor universe, built for up to 4 players! Construct incredible machines using scrap, and prepare to face off against your creepy Neighbor and his army of evil bots. Whether you roll, fly, or bounce, victory is yours with any machine that gets the job done! Success is defined by your creative designs!

https://i.imgur.com/UFXPuyc.gif

In Hello Engineer, there's something for everyone. If you're just starting your journey and want to master the tools, we recommend the story mode. You'll find yourself trapped in the park with the Neighbor determined to keep you from escaping. To complete your mission, you'll need to assemble incredible contraptions, conquer challenging levels, uncover hidden easter eggs, and unravel the plot.

https://i.imgur.com/AY8cdXD.gif

If you're more into building and assembling, check out the sandbox mode. Here, you'll scavenge, craft, and create new vehicles using almost unlimited resources. Let your imagination run wild!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1856190/Hello_Engineer/

Make sure that you have Hello Engineer on your wishlist to be in the know about any news & updates leading up to our full game launch. And feel free to join our Discord server. We have dedicated channels just for feedback and we’d love to hear what you think!

Cheers,

notes.title: ⚙ Calling all inventors! The Brand New Hello Engineer Demo is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Hello there! 

Today all you, talented inventors, can put your creative abilities to the test. Take on challenges and unleash your inner engineer with The Brand New Hello Engineer Demo! 

[previewyoutube=fHhyalR-hWI;full][/previewyoutube]Check out the Demo teaser!

Jump into the multiplayer machinery-building construction game set in the beloved yet mysteriously abandoned - Golden Apple Amusement Park!

Wait…did you all of a sudden find yourself trapped in the park? We’ve heard that Mr. Peterson might have something to do with that. 

https://i.imgur.com/2LCuEtm.gif


In order to escape you will need to build incredible (sometimes even weird) constructions made of suspicious scrap, and challenge the creepy Neighbor and his minions. Sharpen up on the basics & learn game mechanics, put together different machines to overcome the Neighbor’s challenges, and experience the beginning of a multi-act campaign.  


https://i.imgur.com/QMUUC7S.gif


Scavenge, craft, create new vehicles with almost unlimited resources in a sandbox mode. You will find the variety of details scattered around the Amusement Park such as wooden planks, metal pipes, scrawny wheels, and even dynamite to invent ingenious constructions that will help you to conquer the landscape and find the best route to thard-to-reach places. Don’t forget to invite the rest of the Neighborhood Rescue Squad to have even more fun!


https://i.imgur.com/NpijHkU.gif


The only limitation in the game is your imagination. Dreamed about recreating a vehicle from your favorite movie? Try this out! We’re looking forward to seeing where your fantasy puts you in the end. 


https://i.imgur.com/wAHv6k4.gif

Make sure that you have Hello Engineer on your wishlist to be in the know about any news & updates leading up to our full game launch. If you liked the Demo, please feel free to join our Discord server. We have dedicated channels just for feedback and we’d love to hear what you think!

Cheers,

notes.title: Moustaches & Mysteries - Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now!
notes.content:
https://i.imgur.com/EEDpbLg.gif
[hr][/hr]Ready your cameras and prepare to begin your investigation!

Hello Neighbor 2 is Available Now!

It's time to renew your investigation and return to the sleepy little town with a bit of a missing person problem and a whole a lot of mystery. Can you get to the bottom of what's really going on in Raven Brooks? Dive deeper into the town's dark secrets and uncover new sides to the story of how Mr. Peterson became "The Neighbor." 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1321680/Hello_Neighbor_2/
[hr][/hr]
Attend the exclusive advance viewing of Welcome to Raven Brooks

Want to see Hello Neighbor Animated Series: Welcome to Raven Brooks before anyone else? Simply start up your last Hello Neighbor 2 save! Yes, you heard that right, we are literally throwing the exclusive premiere of Welcome To Raven Brooks, from inside Raven brooks! 

So when you come across a strange television set with a countdown timer on it, go ahead and grab some popcorn and snacks before the big show! And if you missed the initial showing don't worry!

You can catch the replay on our YouTube channel Dec 11th at 10:00AM PT!
Game Editions
Hello Neighbor 2: Deluxe Edition

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38017141/8abd7c0d41bd40ed5d232fb8d78a873c0ce9037f.png
Level up your investigative tools, meet new Neighbors, & explore new locations + puzzles with the Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edtion! 

The Hello Neighbor 2 Deluxe Edition includes 3 day-one DLC:

📚 Late Fees- Will you uncover something sinister in the endless maze of books that is the Raven Brooks Library? Only one way to find out!

🏫 Back To School - Investigate the sprawling Raven Brooks Middle School for clues. But beware the creepy janitor and his fiendish 4-legged friends!

🚁 Hello-copter - Surveil your Neighbors in style! This top-of-the-line gadget lets you spy on your suspects from safety and pilfer items with its retractable grappling claw!

Watch the launch day trailer

[previewyoutube=RvUEaHljElg;full][/previewyoutube]
[hr][/hr]
Elevate your experience and increase your immersion with CORSAIR's iCUE technology. Synchronizing the RGB lighting on all your compatible CORSAIR devices gives you a setup-wide light show to go with your small-town-wide sneaking. 🔎

Before we sign off, I'd like to take a moment to say a big, heartfelt thank you on behalf of the team to our amazing community of Neighbors near and far, both past and present! Thank you all for being right there with us playing through every new build, demo, and alpha over the past 5 years. We hope you enjoy the game as much as we enjoyed developing it, and please stay tuned for updates and post-launch news. 

As always, we’ll see you in Raven Brooks.

Cheers!

notes.title: Hello Engineer - Coming to Steam in 2023!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43282570/9945f8060e7dfbdcfb04a343b1094d75cce0695c.png

🛠 Calling all inventors! ⚙
Hello Engineer is coming to steam in 2023!
[hr][/hr]
Check out the multiplayer machinery-building construction game set in the  grounds of a location many fans of all things Neighbor are quite familiar with

The (in)famous Golden Apple Amusement Park,

https://i.imgur.com/fx0LdcW.gif

Scavenge, craft, and overcome challenges throughout the sandbox world of the derelict and dangerous park, originally built by Mr. Peterson himself! 

Put together incredible machines built of (sometimes rather questionable) scrap. Use wheels, weapons, and even jet engines(?!) you find around the amusement park as you and the rest of the Neighborhood Rescue Squad desperately attempt to escape The Neighbor and his clanking creations! 

There is no right or wrong way to complete objectives and how you progress through each level is entirely up to you! The most important ingredient is your creativity, and we can't wait to see what you create.

https://i.imgur.com/kPN3cK9.gif

https://i.imgur.com/vvb6r79.gif

The Hello Engineer Steam page is now available, please Wishlist and Follow us there to stay up-to-date on all the latest news and updates leading up to our Steam Launch!

Thanks for joining us, Let us know what you're most excited about in the comments, and stop by again soon!

Cheers!
